description: Record one or a batch of COMPLETED strength, endurance, or mobility exercises into a signed-in athlete's append-only STRUGGL training ledger, updating e1RM PRs, 17-muscle weekly volume, and the STRUGGL app's read-only connector feed (with duplicate-write protection and physiology guardrail advisories). Use only for workouts already performed (prefer `sessions` batch array for multi-exercise sessions); to schedule future workouts on the calendar, use `plan_workout` instead. Requires `write`-scoped Bearer or OAuth 2.1 token.

comments.description: Optional athlete notes, splits, or perceived feel for single-exercise logging.

date.description: Workout ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today; acts as fallback date for `sessions`).

debrief_summary.description: Concise coaching takeaways rendered under the workout card in the STRUGGL app feed.

distance_km.description: Completed distance in kilometers for running, rowing, SkiErg, or cycling.

duration_min.description: Completed session duration in minutes for endurance or mobility work.

exercise.description: Exercise name when logging a single movement (omit when passing `sessions`).

reps.description: Completed repetitions per working set for a single-exercise call (1–100).

rpe.description: Completed session RPE (1–10). When omitted, inferred deterministically from the athlete's rolling 30-day e1RM capacity envelope.

session_title.description: Optional workout card header title (e.g. 'Pull Hypertrophy S20').

sessions.description: Batch of completed exercises to log atomically as one consolidated workout card.

comments.description: Optional coaching cue, split target, tempo note, or athlete feedback.

date.description: ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD for this item (inherits top-level `date` when omitted).

distance_km.description: Distance covered in kilometers for running, rowing, SkiErg, or cycling.

duration_min.description: Total duration in minutes for endurance, conditioning, or mobility blocks.

exercise.description: Canonical or natural movement name (e.g. 'Back Squat', 'Pull-Up', 'Zone 2 Run').

exercise_type.description: Movement modality classification used for volume vs endurance load routing.

reps.description: Target or completed repetitions per working set (1–100).

rpe.description: Borg CR10 / RIR-based session or set RPE (1–10; sets < 6.0 are excluded from hypertrophy hard-set volume).

session_aim.description: Optional physiological aim of this session (e.g. 'Aerobic base + lactate clearance').

session_title.description: Optional per-day session card header when batching a multi-day plan.

sets.description: Working set count for strength or interval prescriptions (1–50).

weight_kg.description: External load in kg (ADDED belt load for pull-ups/chin-ups/dips; total bar+plates for barbell lifts).

sets.description: Completed working sets for a single-exercise call (1–50).

weight_kg.description: External load in kg (ADDED belt load for pull-ups/chin-ups/dips; total bar load otherwise).

name: log_workout

advisories.description: Deterministic load, capacity, or RPE consistency guardrail warnings.

result.description: Human-readable persistence summary of logged movements.

saved.description: True when the completed workout row(s) persisted cleanly.

trace_id.description: Audit trace identifier linking ledger rows and app feed cards.

title: Log Completed Workout (Single or Batch)
